# Marketplace plugin catalog

One row per marketplace plugin: `name — [keywords] — description`. Regenerated by scripts/generate.sh; consumed by the plugin-scout skill.

always-on-suite — [suite, generic, hooks] — Meta-bundle: the user-scope baseline — project-agnostic plugins worth enabling once in ~/.claude/settings.json and keeping on in every repo. secret-scanning's write-time secret block, candor's honesty Stop gate, lean's output pricing, terse's chat-brevity contract (inert until you set a level), file-aware skill auto-routing (skill-router), git-workflow discipline, cross-session friction mining (hindsight), and plugin-scout for the per-project plugins this bundle leaves out — command-guard among them, whose ask tier replaces the host's own permission classifier. Membership is prose, not script-checked. /always-on-suite:uninstall removes the bundle and prunes what it installed.
api-design — [api, backend, review] — APIs in both directions: design your own (resource naming, status-code discipline, pagination/filtering/sorting, versioning, RFC 9457 errors, idempotency, Laravel API Resources, plus a graphql-grpc skill for non-REST surfaces; /api-design:review and spec-first /api-design:scaffold) and consume others' honestly — verify current official API/SDK docs before writing integration code (UserPromptSubmit reminder + /api-design:check, the api-docs-first skill) and keep your own docs true after a change with the docs-upkeep drift scan: README claims, changelog gaps, stale examples, dead links (/api-design:drift).
approaches — [process, planning] — Solution-approach deliberation before non-trivial implementation: 2-3 structurally different approaches with trade-offs and a kill-trigger, a strategy catalog mapped to the risk each beats, a four-persona blind opinion round for refactor-shaped tasks — plus the merged pre-code disciplines: build-vs-buy checks, S/M/L/XL estimation, rollout planning, and design-pattern selection. Includes /approaches:compare, /approaches:opinions, /approaches:build-vs-buy, /approaches:size, /approaches:rollout, /approaches:pattern.
brain — [tooling, hooks] — A committed, Obsidian-style codebase map for a project: brain/INDEX.md indexes areas, key files, and notable classes/entrypoints so a fresh Claude session starts oriented. A SessionStart hook injects the compact map (with a staleness hint when it lags HEAD); /brain reads it and /brain index builds/refreshes it. Builds the map only — it never annotates code, and nothing outside brain/ is ever modified.
candor — [generic, quality, hooks] — Candour as a mechanism, not a pep talk. A blocking Stop gate carries the two dishonesty shapes a script can prove: a file:line citation resolving to no file under cwd or to a line past the file's end, and a position retracted after challenge-shaped pushback with no tool call in between. Flattery openers, apologies, defensive phrasing and emotional intensifiers are counted by /candor:check and blocked by nothing, on purpose. Ships the straight-talk skill: six orderings, not sentiments. Completion claims stay with code-architecture.
claude-authoring — [tooling] — Authoring guides for Claude Code artifacts — skills, agents, commands, hooks, plugins — plus a routine-detector that suggests scaffolding a project skill when work turns repetitive, a project-skill-suggester that proactively offers one when a task's cards share uncovered repository-specific knowledge, and /claude-authoring:new-skill|new-agent|new-command|new-hook|new-plugin scaffold commands.
code-architecture — [process, quality] — Engineering process: plan-before-code, YAGNI, SOLID principles applied with judgment, task orchestration, work verification — enforced by a blocking Stop hook that refuses a completion claim when files were edited but nothing ran afterward — low-cognitive-load code, KISS/DRY simplicity principles. Owns code-level structure — units, interfaces, file placement; defers system-level topology (service boundaries, scaling, caching) to the system-design plugin.
code-review — [review, quality] — Stack-agnostic code review: correctness bugs, code smells, convention drift on any diff or PR — severity-sorted one-line findings — plus comment discipline: every fact routed to the artifact that cannot lie about it, comments spent only on why-not-the-obvious, external constraints, intentional silence and contract facts (default: no comment; write-time hooks warn, and deny the three strictest patterns plus any whole file over a 0.4:1 comment ceiling, once per file per session; /code-review:comment-review). Defers structure/YAGNI to code-architecture, security depth to security, stack idioms to the per-framework review plugins. Includes /code-review:review, a code-reviewer agent, the code-smells, reuse-hygiene and comment-discipline skills. The fan-in for overlapping review surfaces: loads every installed matching stack skill in one pass.
command-guard — [security, hooks, governance] — Destructive-command prevention: a PreToolUse hook that classifies every Bash (and MCP shell/SQL) command before it runs — denying irreversible data loss (migrate:fresh, db:wipe, DROP DATABASE, rm -rf /, git clean -fdx, docker compose down -v, terraform destroy, cloud deletes) and prompting on scoped-but-destructive ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf ./dir, kubectl delete pod). Reads through quotes, wrappers and heredocs; skips read-only commands; fail-open. Ships /command-guard:check and a user-owned allow-file the agent cannot edit.
craft-layer — [ui-ux, frontend, review] — Create unique, animated, informative web apps (CRM, SaaS, landing pages) across React, Tailwind, Vue, Next, Nuxt, and Laravel. /craft-layer:craft runs the studio pipeline end to end — creative direction, design research, asset sourcing with a licence gate, theming and component build via ui-ux, and a tiered motion system (Framer, anime.js, Three.js/R3F, Lottie/Rive, sprites) with reduced-motion and reduced-bundle fallbacks. /craft-layer:sections guides per-section decisions, /craft-layer:audit reviews a shipped tree, and ultra-craft escalates a run with live web research and a red-team of the result. Ships the Three.js/R3F skill (WebGPU-first, TSL, asset pipelines, disposal) behind /craft-layer:review. Requires ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit.
craft-suite — [suite, frontend, ui-ux] — Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog (craft-layer), visual decisions rendered with the project's own components in any UI library, and live component-registry MCP sourcing (design-lab) — WebGL/Three.js effects now ship inside craft-layer — plus the companion the studio requires: ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit. Split out of frontend-suite so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /craft-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
database — [database, review, worker] — Relational databases in one plugin: the engine-agnostic sql-best-practices skill (sargable predicates, joins, indexes, NULL logic, transactions, keyset pagination, safe migrations, parameterization), the mariadb-best-practices dialect skill (10.6+ divergences, RETURNING, sequences, system-versioned tables, Galera), one /database:review that detects the engine and loads the dialect skill only for MariaDB, a database-engineer worker that applies schema, migration, indexing and pooling work, and a PreToolUse guard that asks before a destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/unqualified DELETE-UPDATE) lands.
debugging — [process, quality] — Systematic debugging: root cause before any fix — reproduce first, read the actual error, isolate with hypothesis tests and bisection, one change at a time, verify against the original symptom; escalation rule after three failed fixes. Ships a delegatable debugger agent for handing off the long reproduce-bisect investigation. Includes /debugging:debug.
design-lab — [ui-ux, frontend, tooling, research, navigator] — See real components before deciding: /design-lab:preview renders 2-3 candidate variants with the project's OWN components on its own dev server (Vite React/Vue/Nuxt or Laravel Blade/Livewire, scratch surface removed at cleanup, strict consent gate, shell-mockup fallback for greenfield); and two MCP servers read component registries from the source, never from memory — a dependency-free local one for Aceternity, shadcn and Magic UI (24h-cached, every answer carrying its source URL, fetch date and stale flag, 3D/particle runtimes flagged) plus ReUI's own hosted server, delivered by install and authenticated by the user's own browser sign-in.
devops — [devops, pipeline, review, worker] — Infrastructure in one plugin: CI/CD ordering, container/image hygiene, Kubernetes limits and probes, deploy strategy with rollback, and secrets handling (devops-practices); Dockerfile and compose discipline (docker-best-practices); and local dev environments generated from evidence — manifests, lockfiles, .env DSNs, CI images — via /devops:init (compose-init). One /devops:review loads the Docker skill when a Dockerfile or compose file is in scope, backed by a PreToolUse guard on workflow files and a devops-engineer worker + devops-reviewer pair. Owns infra-layer observability wiring; defers in-code instrumentation to resilience's observability skill.
fresh-take — [quality, tooling] — Independent stronger-model second opinion at key moments — stuck debugging or an imminent irreversible action. /fresh-take:consult composes a facts-only brief (no leaning) and dispatches a blind stronger-model consultant with read-only repo access; it returns a Take, Risks, and one Alternative. A UserPromptSubmit reminder hook nudges the command on key-moment phrases. Advice only — it never blocks, gates, or edits anything.
frontend-suite — [suite, frontend] — Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, web-dev (Next.js, React Native, Vite skills with /web-dev:review, the generalist worker and the opus-floored frontend-reviewer), the WCAG audit inside ui-ux, skill auto-routing (skill-router), and code-review (the review fan-in plus comment discipline: no-comment default, write-time denies for restatement, commented-out code, signature-repeating docblocks and files over the comment ceiling). Inertia lives in the laravel plugin (php-suite). The creative-build studio — craft-layer (with its Three.js skill) and design-lab — moved to craft-suite, so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
git-workflow — [git, process] — Git workflow discipline: isolated worktrees for feature work, a structured finish protocol for development branches (verify, present options, merge/PR/park, clean up), and review-exchange rigor — what to include when requesting review, and technical verification before implementing received feedback. Includes /git-workflow:finish.
hindsight — [process, tooling] — Cross-session self-improvement loop: mines session transcripts for recurring friction and proposes CLAUDE.md rules, skill/plugin ideas, and failed-approach warnings — applied only on approval.
laravel — [backend, review, worker] — Laravel best practices: Eloquent N+1 prevention, form requests, service layer, queues, policies, a per-version leverage map (Laravel 11/12/13), mass-assignment security — and the Inertia.js skill (v1/v2/v3, Vue/React/Svelte adapters: partial reloads, deferred props, useForm, shared data, SSR) it pairs with — behind one /laravel:review that loads Inertia when the manifests show it, plus the backend-engineer worker (PHP/Laravel) the review routes its fixes to.
lean — [generic, quality, process, hooks] — Prices every output as a debit and asks how much. Five surfaces, one bar each: code, tests, comments, files, and actions — a tool call, subagent spawn or verify pass whose result cannot change the next step is a paid no-op, and nothing else here prices that. Only four things buy more than the minimum: blast radius, an observed defect, a stated criterion, the user asking; the excess must name which, where it happens. Minimum means risk coverage, not count — never delete a test to hit a ratio.
llm-app — [backend, review] — LLM application engineering: eval harnesses and regression gates (evaluate, don't eyeball), RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, retrieval quality + re-ranking, grounding and citation), prompt versioning, prompt-injection defense, token-cost control, and context management — a firing llm-app skill and a /llm-app:review command. Defers provider API specifics to Claude Code's built-in claude-api skill (harness-provided, not part of this marketplace).
orchestration — [process, worker] — Subagent orchestration discipline: delegation contracts (self-contained prompts, compressed evidence-backed returns, model/effort tiering, scout-then-fanout, writer isolation), verification panels (refuter voting, judge panels, loop-until-dry, completeness critic), plus the shared contract review commands route their fix lists through. Includes /orchestration:review.
payments — [backend, security, review] — Payments and billing discipline (Stripe/Paddle/Braintree): PCI scope minimization via tokenization, integer-minor-unit money, signature-verified idempotent webhooks, subscription state machines and activation races, dunning and proration, and an append-only ledger with reconciliation — a firing payments skill and a /payments:review command. The failure class is double-charges and revenue leaks.
php-suite — [suite, backend] — Meta-bundle: the PHP category in one install — laravel (Laravel best practices and the Inertia.js skill behind one /laravel:review, plus the backend-engineer worker), web-dev (the generalist worker, the frontend-reviewer, and the Vite skill for Laravel's default asset bundler via /web-dev:review) and code-review (the review fan-in plus comment discipline: no-comment default, write-time denies for restatement, commented-out code, signature-repeating docblocks and files over the comment ceiling). Uninstall cleanly with /php-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
plugin-scout — [tooling] — Scan the current project's manifests and suggest every cc-plugins-marketplace plugin in three tiers — stack-matched, the curated any-project core, and the universal remainder — then install the picked ones after confirmation; --yes auto-installs the first two tiers, --full installs everything relevant to the detected stack after one plan confirm (--stack a,b,c fills in a stack the manifests do not show yet), --all offers every row explicitly, --persist/--global choose scope. Includes /plugin-scout:suggest.
process-suite — [suite, process] — Meta-bundle: the engineering-process category in one install — git workflow, approach deliberation (with the build-vs-buy, estimation, rollout, and pattern-selection disciplines folded into approaches), hindsight mining, docs discipline (api-design's docs-first check and drift scan), subagent orchestration, task execution, stack scanning, plugin scouting, a token-cost warn hook (lean), and file-aware skill auto-routing (skill-router). Uninstall cleanly with /process-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
quality-principles-suite — [generic, quality, review, suite] — Meta-bundle: the code-quality disciplines that advise rather than enforce — approach deliberation and design patterns, OWASP security review and threat modeling, systematic debugging, resilience (failure modes, error handling, concurrency, observability, measure-first performance), dependency hygiene and stack inventory (stack-scan), and test design and coverage review. Accessibility auditing lives in ui-ux (frontend-suite, craft-suite). Split out of quality-suite so a project can take the enforcing half without the advisory half's always-on context; the membership rule is prose, not script-checked. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-principles-suite:uninstall. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
quality-suite — [suite, quality] — Meta-bundle: the code-quality plugins that carry an enforcement mechanism — review and code smells with the single-pass fan-in, architecture's evidence-at-claim Stop gate, candor's citation-and-reversal Stop gate, comment discipline (warn-on-write plus a narrow pre-write deny), destructive-command blocking, secret-leak prevention, a token-cost warn hook (lean), and file-aware skill auto-routing. The advisory nine live in quality-principles-suite; the membership rule is prose, not script-checked. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-suite:uninstall.
resilience — [backend, review] — Runtime quality in one plugin — does it stay up, can you see it, is it fast. Failure-mode design for integration points (timeouts, retries with backoff and idempotency, circuit breaking, graceful degradation, delivery semantics) with the merged error-handling and concurrency disciplines; application observability (structured logs with correlation IDs, RED/USE metrics without cardinality bombs, trace propagation, honest health checks); and measure-first performance (N+1, payload, bundle, Core Web Vitals, cache correctness, percentile load tests). Five audits — /resilience:review, :error-review, :concurrency-review, :observability-review, :performance-review — and two workers, observability-engineer and performance-engineer, that apply only what a measurement or a finding proves.
secret-scanning — [security, hooks] — Secret-leak prevention: a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Write/Edit introducing a high-confidence secret (cloud keys, private-key blocks, provider tokens, assigned secret literals) before it reaches disk, plus a /secret-scanning:scan command to sweep a path or diff on demand. Fail-open, high-confidence-only, with a fixture escape.
security — [security, review, worker] — Security for web apps: OWASP-aligned code review (injection, XSS, CSRF, authz vs authn, mass assignment, uploads, secrets, dependency audit) mapped to PHP/Laravel and JS/Vue, PLUS design-phase threat-modeling (STRIDE, trust boundaries), a data-privacy (GDPR/CCPA) regulatory lens, and an api-auth lens (token model, OAuth2+PKCE, scopes). Includes /security:review and a security-engineer worker agent.
skill-router — [tooling, hooks] — File-aware skill auto-routing: a PostToolUse hook injects one additionalContext directive to load the relevant best-practice skill(s) when you edit a matching file (PHP/Laravel/Blade, React/Vue/Inertia/Livewire via .tsx/.jsx/.vue, plain .ts/.js/.py/.go/.rb/.rs, SQL and migrations with engine-aware MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL rows, components, tests, Dockerfiles, OpenAPI), a SessionStart hook primes a repo-tailored skill index, and low-confidence content signals flush as one digest on your next prompt (SessionEnd keeps the ledger). Every relevant skill co-fires per edit; fail-open, once per skill per session.
stack-scan — [tooling] — Know what is actually installed, then keep it healthy: /stack-scan:report inventories manifests and lockfiles (composer, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun), runtimes, engine constraints and docker images into a required-vs-installed table with drift, missing locks and EOL majors flagged; /stack-scan:audit runs the composer/npm vulnerability, outdated and licence checks (package-hygiene: semver strategy, lockfile discipline, upgrade lanes, licences against the distribution mode) — report-only. Whether to add a dependency at all is approaches' build-vs-buy.
system-design — [process, review, worker] — System-level design: service boundaries on data ownership, scaling paths, cache placement, sync vs async integration and its failure modes, single points of failure, plus domain modeling (bounded contexts, aggregates, ubiquitous language) and an event-driven skill (delivery semantics, outbox, sagas, DLQ) — firing system-design, domain-modeling, and event-driven skills, a /system-design:review command, and a system-architect worker + system-design-reviewer pair. Complements code-architecture (code-level structure) without overlapping it.
task-runner — [worker, process, generic] — Disciplined task execution: one task at a time, scope locked to the task, bounded verify-fix inner loop per task, no drift, no unbounded outer loop. Completion means every check passed with evidence. Ships the shared task-executor agent — the delegatable 'apply the fixes' sink every review routes to — and a PostToolUse scope-lock tripwire that flags edits outside the current task's declared files. Includes parallel-planning: computed subagents-vs-inline verdict with dependency levels, agent count, and speedup estimate via /task-runner:plan.
taskmaster — [planning, process] — Idea-to-execution clarification: brainstorm fuzzy ideas into approved designs, grill requirements until zero ambiguity, deliberate the implementation approach with a blind four-persona round (via the approaches plugin when installed; inline 2-3 approaches otherwise), decide visual choices with mockups, validate whole experiences with an interactive clickable demo, then emit milestone-grouped single-prompt task cards. Outputs live under taskmaster-docs/ (no collision with a project's own docs/).
taskmaster-suite — [suite, planning] — Meta-bundle (10 plugins): the clarification-to-execution pipeline and only what it dispatches into — taskmaster planning, task-runner execution, orchestration, code-architecture, approaches, stack-scan, skill-router, plus the ui-ux, testing and security lanes its cards route to. Trimmed from 32 on 2026-08-31 to fit the host's skill-listing budget: over that cap the host drops descriptions name-only and the surviving set varies per reload, so the extra members cost reachability for every member. Install the rest individually. Uninstall cleanly with /taskmaster-suite:uninstall. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
terse — [generic, quality, hooks] — Chat-message brevity as a shape contract, not a word filter: prose-line budgets per turn kind, a fixed work-done skeleton (verdict → artifacts → max 5 findings → blocker → next), and a named cut list. Levels lite/full/ultra plus wenyan (classical-Chinese novelty) variants, hook-reinforced each turn. Out of scope: code, files written, subagent prompts, and how much work a turn does. Ships /terse:commit, /terse:compress, /terse:check, three compressed-return agents, and an opt-in MCP catalog shrinker.
testing — [testing, review, worker] — Testing best practices: test pyramid and what to actually test, Pest/PHPUnit and Vitest/Jest idioms, Playwright/Dusk e2e discipline, factories and fixtures, mocking boundaries, flaky-test causes, coverage traps — plus the TDD workflow (red-green-refactor, red-green regression proof for bug fixes). Includes /testing:review, /testing:flake-hunt and a test-engineer worker agent.
ui-ux — [ui-ux, frontend, review, worker] — UI/UX best practices with per-stack skills: shadcn/ui, ReUI, Aceternity UI, Astryx, Material UI, Tailwind, plus a library-agnostic component-libraries skill (headless and styled React libraries, owned-code vs dependency rules, a per-library map) — plus a design-tokens skill (spacing/type/radius/elevation/motion scales + semantic color tiering), a theming-system skill, theme creation with a live colour preview, a /ui-ux:build entry point, a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit (/ui-ux:audit, the a11y-audit skill, and an a11y-engineer worker that applies the fix list with native semantics over ARIA patches), and ui-ux-reviewer + ui-ux-engineer agents.
ultra-deep-research — [research] — Deep-research harness that fans out parallel web searches, tiers sources by provenance, extracts date-stamped claims, and adversarially refutes them before synthesizing a cited report with a contradiction ledger and per-section confidence. Trigger 'ultra-deep-research' escalates to a Workflow-driven loop-until-dry fan-out with multi-vote refutation panels; standard depth runs a portable parallel-Agent fan-out. Ships /ultra-deep-research:research plus researcher and verifier subagents. Writes the report inline and to research/<topic>-<date>.md.
vercel-skills-scout — [tooling, research] — Scout skills.sh — Vercel's open agent-skills directory — for third-party skills matching the project's stack: scans manifests, queries the skills.sh search API, reports each hit with provenance (source repo, install count, skills.sh URL), previews the picked skills' SKILL.md before anything lands, then installs only explicit picks via npx skills add — project-level, never global, never auto-installed. Includes /vercel-skills-scout:suggest.
web-dev — [frontend, backend, worker, review] — Web development in one plugin: a web-developer worker (routing, REST/API integration, forms, state, SSR/CSR), an opus-floored frontend-reviewer for component and view logic, and three version-pinned stack skills — Next.js (App Router boundaries, opt-in caching, server actions, 14→16), React Native (lists, navigation, native-driver animation, Expo inversions), Vite (VITE_ env security, chunking, base, proxy, 5→8) — with /web-dev:review detecting the stack from the lockfile. Inertia and Laravel stay in their own plugins; plain JS/TS needs no skill.
